content: TypeSafe Jev (docs.typesafe.ai/models, 2026-09): input tokens $0.042/Mtok, output tokens free, no documented free tier. Limits: 1,200 req/min, 250k tok/s, 64k tokens per request (32k for state + longest question). 429 on limit (SDK honors retry-after-ms), 529 overloaded. Models jev-latest/jev-preview -> jev-1.13.0. No server-side batch endpoint; SDK systemOneAll is client-side concurrency (default 4). Max 255 options per Choice.
